يختطفان (form VIII)
# يَخْتَطِفَانِ (yaḵtaṭifāni) /jax.ta.tˤi.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
# يُخْتَطَفَانِ (yuḵtaṭafāni) /jux.ta.tˤa.faː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِخْتَطَفَ (iḵtaṭafa)
